items.name: utils
items.description: cn()/cv() class utilities and custom-element interop helpers.

items.name: theme
items.description: shadcn-compatible CSS variable tokens (light + dark) for Tailwind v4.

items.name: roving-focus
items.description: Roving-tabindex keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End, wrap) for composite widgets like tabs.

items.name: dismissable-layer
items.description: Escape-key + outside-pointer dismissal with a LIFO layer stack, for dialogs, popovers, and dropdowns.

items.name: focus
items.description: Focus trap and focus restore for modal surfaces like dialogs.

items.name: floating
items.description: Anchored positioning for floating elements: side/align placement, viewport flip, scroll/resize tracking.

items.name: typeahead
items.description: Printable-key item search for menus and listboxes, with Radix cycle-on-repeat semantics.

items.name: portal
items.description: Move a component subtree into another container (document.body by default) to escape overflow/transform/z-index stacking contexts.

items.name: button
items.description: Displays a button. Port of shadcn/ui button.

items.name: badge
items.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge. Port of shadcn/ui badge.

items.name: label
items.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls. Port of shadcn/ui label.

items.name: separator
items.description: Visually or semantically separates content. Port of shadcn/ui separator.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A placeholder to show while content is loading. Port of shadcn/ui skeleton.

items.name: alert
items.description: Displays a callout for user attention. Port of shadcn/ui alert.

items.name: card
items.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer. Port of shadcn/ui card.

items.name: input
items.description: A native form input with theme styling. Port of shadcn/ui input.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A native multi-line text input with theme styling. Port of shadcn/ui textarea.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox styled with pure CSS. Port of shadcn/ui checkbox.

items.name: switch
items.description: A native toggle switch styled with pure CSS. Port of shadcn/ui switch.

items.name: tabs
items.description: A set of layered sections of content, displayed one at a time. Port of shadcn/ui tabs.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections. Port of shadcn/ui accordion.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: An interactive component that expands/collapses a panel. Port of shadcn/ui collapsible.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A set of native radio buttons where only one can be selected. Port of shadcn/ui radio-group.

items.name: select
items.description: A native select styled like shadcn/ui's native-select, with a themeable chevron.

items.name: form-field
items.description: A label + control + description + error composition helper that wires ids and aria. Port of shadcn/ui field.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A modal dialog overlaying the page. Port of shadcn/ui dialog.

items.name: table
items.description: A responsive table built from real table elements. Port of shadcn/ui table.

items.name: avatar
items.description: An image element with a fallback for representing a user. Port of shadcn/ui avatar.

items.name: progress
items.description: Displays an indicator showing completion progress of a task. Port of shadcn/ui progress.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A floating label shown on hover/focus. Port of shadcn/ui tooltip.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links. Port of shadcn/ui breadcrumb.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Pagination with page navigation, previous/next, and ellipsis. Port of shadcn/ui pagination.

items.name: toast
items.description: A toaster stack + toast() function, sonner-style. Original zero-dep implementation.

items.name: popover
items.description: Floating content anchored to a trigger. Port of shadcn/ui popover.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with an important choice. Port of shadcn/ui alert-dialog.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A dialog that slides in from a screen edge. Port of shadcn/ui sheet.

items.name: slider
items.description: A native range slider styled to match shadcn/ui slider (single thumb).

items.name: toggle
items.description: A two-state button that can be on or off. Port of shadcn/ui toggle.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: A set of two-state buttons with single or multiple selection. Port of shadcn/ui toggle-group.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: A themed scroll container with native scrolling and a thin styled scrollbar. Port of shadcn/ui scroll-area.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A menu of actions or choices triggered by a button. Port of shadcn/ui dropdown-menu.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A pointer-hover card that reveals a floating preview. Port of shadcn/ui hover-card.

items.name: command
items.description: A command palette: type-to-filter list with keyboard highlight and selection. Visuals from shadcn/ui command; cmdk-convention behavior, zero-dep.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: A non-modal menu bar of triggers and content panels. Port of shadcn/ui navigation-menu.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: Displays content within a desired aspect ratio. Port of shadcn/ui aspect-ratio.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: A menu opened by right-clicking, positioned at the pointer. Port of shadcn/ui context-menu.

items.name: menubar
items.description: A horizontal bar of menus (like an application menu). Port of shadcn/ui menubar.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Displays keyboard input or a group of keys. Port of shadcn/ui kbd.

items.name: drawer
items.description: A draggable edge panel (bottom by default) with drag-to-dismiss. Port of shadcn/ui drawer (vaul).

items.name: spinner
items.description: An animated loading status icon. Port of shadcn/ui spinner.

items.name: combobox
items.description: An autocomplete select — a Popover + Command composition with single/multiple selection. Classic shadcn/ui combobox pattern.

items.name: resizable
items.description: Resizable panel groups with draggable handles. Port of shadcn/ui resizable (react-resizable-panels).

items.name: button-group
items.description: Groups related buttons and controls together. Port of shadcn/ui button-group.

items.name: input-otp
items.description: A one-time-password input: a single native input overlaying slot cells. Port of shadcn/ui input-otp.

items.name: carousel
items.description: A slide carousel with drag, prev/next, and keyboard nav. Port of shadcn/ui carousel (embla).

items.name: use-mobile
items.description: A reactive viewport-width signal (isMobile) matching shadcn/ui's use-mobile hook.

items.name: empty
items.description: An empty-state block with icon, title, description, and actions. Port of shadcn/ui empty.

items.name: item
items.description: A flexible list row with media, content, actions, and separators. Port of shadcn/ui item.

items.name: input-group
items.description: Combines inputs, textareas, buttons, and addons into one control group. Port of shadcn/ui input-group.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A composable, collapsible sidebar with a provider, frame variants, and a full menu/group part family. Port of shadcn/ui sidebar.

items.name: direction
items.description: Provides an LTR or RTL writing direction to descendant components. Port of shadcn/ui direction.

items.name: marker
items.description: A styled marker row with icon and content parts. Port of shadcn/ui marker.

items.name: calendar
items.description: A date-picker calendar grid with single/range selection and keyboard nav. Original behavior; visuals from shadcn/ui calendar.

items.name: message
items.description: A chat message row with avatar/content/header/footer. Port of shadcn/ui message.

items.name: bubble
items.description: A chat bubble (the coloured message body) with variants and alignment. Port of shadcn/ui bubble.

items.name: attachment
items.description: A file/attachment chip with upload-state, size, and orientation variants. Port of shadcn/ui attachment.

items.name: message-scroller
items.description: A scroll container for chat messages with stick-to-bottom autoscroll and a scroll-to-end button. Port of shadcn/ui message-scroller.
